# bytesized

a nim library for manipulating data storage units

## usage

there are multiple ways to use `bytesized`, with more to come soon.

some examples: 

`convertBytes(2048, Units.MiB, Units.GiB)` returns `2.0`

`convertBytes(17179869184, Units.GiB)` returns `16.0`

-- 

I will make better docs when this package is more feature complete
